D: A reprogrammed Terminator protects young John Connor from the liquid metal T-1000.
P: Serve the mains when the Terminator walks into the biker bar to borrow some clothes.
S: Crisp tortillas with refried beans, cheddar and jalapeños, salsa and sour cream

Flour tortillas filled with refried beans, melted cheddar and jalapeños, toasted in a dry pan until crisp, cut into wedges with salsa and sour cream. Spread 4 flour tortillas with 400g refried beans, scatter with 200g grated cheddar and sliced pickled jalapeños, then fold in half. Toast in a dry pan over medium heat for 3 minutes a side, pressing down, until crisp and the cheese melts. Cut into wedges and serve with 200g tomato salsa and 150g sour cream.
Baked pastry turnovers filled with spiced beef, egg and olives
Golden shortcrust half moons filled with cumin-spiced beef, chopped boiled egg and green olives, baked until crisp.
M: Lime and cumin marinated skirt steak in corn tortillas with dried chilli salsa
Skirt steak marinated in lime, garlic and cumin, grilled hot, sliced, in corn tortillas with onion, coriander and salsa roja.
Galleria food court double smash burger

Two thin patties smashed on a smoking griddle with American cheese, pickles, shredded lettuce and tangy burger sauce, wrapped tight in paper. Roll 800g beef mince into 8 balls. Mix 4 tbsp mayo, 1 tbsp relish and 1 tsp mustard for sauce. Heat a griddle until smoking, add the balls and smash flat with a spatula. Season and cook 2 minutes until crusty, flip and top with cheese for 1 minute. Toast 4 buns. Stack two patties on each with sauce, shredded lettuce and pickles, then wrap in baking paper for 2 minutes.
W: Fried churros rolled in cinnamon sugar with a hot chocolate dip

Ridged churros fried crisp and golden, rolled in cinnamon sugar and served with a thick, warm dark chocolate sauce for dunking. Boil 250ml water with 30g butter and a pinch of salt, beat in 150g plain flour until it forms a ball and cool 5 minutes, then beat in 1 egg. Pipe 12cm lengths through a star nozzle into oil at 180C and fry 3 minutes until golden. Roll in 80g caster sugar mixed with 2 tsp cinnamon. Heat 150ml cream and stir in 150g dark chocolate until smooth for dipping.
K: Tequila, lime and orange liqueur blended slushy with ice, salted rim

Tequila, fresh lime and orange liqueur blended with ice into a frosty slush, poured into salt-rimmed glasses with a lime wheel. Rub the rims of 4 glasses with lime and dip in salt. Add 180ml tequila, 90ml fresh lime juice, 60ml orange liqueur, 40ml sugar syrup and 4 cups of ice to a blender. Blend 30 seconds until smooth and slushy. Pour into the glasses and garnish each with a lime wheel. Serve immediately before it shatters into puddles.

s.note: Baked pastry turnovers filled with spiced beef, egg and olives
s.how: Fry 400g beef mince with 1 diced onion, 1 tsp cumin and 1 tsp paprika, then stir in 2 chopped boiled eggs and 50g chopped olives. Cut 3 sheets shortcrust pastry into 12 rounds, fill, fold, crimp, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.
